integrity: Infinite-n claims follow from an analytic block count, Stirling asymptotics, and a dominant-simple-pole argument.
Finite enumeration is supplementary and checks only \(n\le25\).
scientific_limitations: Applies to unweighted path graphs and fixed externality parameter \(\delta\in(1/\varphi,1)\).
The uniform measure on stable equilibria is a counting benchmark and is not the absorption distribution of random-order best-response dynamics.
The support classification is prior work; the contribution is the active-count refinement and its large-deviation profile.
Novelty is literature-based and not guaranteed against all unindexed or unpublished work.
title: The active-population large-deviation law for stable public-goods equilibria on paths
